custody.title: Custody timeline
custody.noneHint: Each hand-over is signed by the actor and anchored on the ledger.
custody.recordHint: Only the stages your role may sign are listed.
custody.signingNote: Signatures are Ed25519 and applied by the server after you sign in (a phone-held key is future work). Each hand-over links to the previous one by hash.

verify.title: Ledger & verification

explain.VERIFIED: Every record was re-hashed and matches the Merkle root stored on the ledger.
explain.PARTIAL: Everything anchored matches the ledger. The newest records are not anchored yet.
explain.PENDING: Nothing has been anchored on the ledger yet.
explain.TAMPERED: At least one record, hand-over or the ledger itself no longer matches what was anchored.
explain.LEDGER_UNREACHABLE: The ledger could not be reached, so nothing could be confirmed.

verify.batchesHint: 50 records per batch; one root per batch is stored on the ledger.
verify.noBatchesHint: A batch is anchored every 50 records, and on each hand-over.
verify.singlePartyNote: Tamper-evident but run by one party: whoever controls it could rewrite it. Hyperledger Fabric with independent peers removes that limit.
verify.noEntries: No ledger entries for this shipment yet
verify.proofHint: Prove one record is part of an anchored batch.
verify.demoTools: Demo tools: tamper with the database
verify.demoToolsHint: DEMO ONLY. Acts like an attacker with database access so you can watch Verify catch it. Restore undoes it.

devices.title: Devices
devices.pairHint: The tag's records will be attributed to this shipment.
devices.addHint: Creates the device and derives its AES-256 key (shown once).
devices.provisioningHint: Write this into the device's encrypted NVS partition, then enable flash encryption. It is not shown again.

sim.title: Device simulator
sim.intro: Virtual hubs and tags speak the real encrypted protocol over MQTT. Start a scenario, then inject heat, ethylene, shocks, network cuts or tampering and watch the system react. All devices here are simulated.
sim.newShipment: Create a new shipment for this run
sim.noRunsHint: Start a scenario above, or wait for the autoplay scenarios to appear.

public.verifiedHint: The readings below were re-checked against a fingerprint stored on the ledger and match.
public.notVerifiedHint: This journey has not been anchored on the ledger yet, so it cannot be confirmed.
public.tamperedHint: Some recorded data no longer matches what was anchored. Treat this journey with caution.
public.coverage: {{pct}} % of records are anchored so far.
public.offlineNote: Grey bands: no mobile network. The device kept recording and uploaded later.
public.demoNote: Demo deployment: the data in this environment is simulated.
